context: Tests whether the agent implements the "commit model.value only when complete" contract for fields that drive rules (since there is no fd:blur event), avoids model/DOM feedback loops, and documents the contract for rule authors in the README Model Properties Set section.

checklist.name: Files, viewType and registration
checklist.description: Files exist under `blocks/form/components/card-number-input/` with matching names, `_card-number-input.json` sets `"fd:viewType": "card-number-input"` with `"fieldType": "text-input"`, and `'card-number-input'` is in `customComponents` in `mappings.js`

checklist.name: Display formatting separate from value
checklist.description: Digits are grouped with spaces for display while typing, and the value committed to the form model is the digits only (no spaces)

checklist.name: Commit only when complete
checklist.description: The form model value is set (or a bubbling `change` event dispatched) only when exactly 16 valid digits are present — NOT on every `input` keystroke — so the field change rule fires once per completed entry

checklist.name: No per-keystroke change propagation
checklist.description: The OOTB per-keystroke change propagation is prevented or not triggered for partial input (e.g. intermediate keystrokes do not dispatch bubbling `change` events or set `model.value`)

checklist.name: Loop guard
checklist.description: When reacting to model `value` changes via `subscribe(..., { listenChanges: true })`, the component compares against the current/displayed value before writing, avoiding an infinite model↔DOM update loop

checklist.name: External value sync
checklist.description: A value set on the model by a rule or prefill (`'change'` with `propertyName === 'value'`) is reflected formatted in the input

checklist.name: README Model Properties Set
checklist.description: `README.md` contains a "Model Properties Set" (or equivalent) section stating when `model.value` is committed (only on complete 16-digit entry), that the value is unformatted digits, and that the field change rule / `fd:change` fires once per completed entry rather than per keystroke

checklist.name: Default export and subscribe import
checklist.description: `card-number-input.js` has a default-export `decorate` and imports `subscribe` from `'../../rules/index.js'` using `{ listenChanges: true }`
